In 余睹與其母文妃密謀立之, 其母文妃 is the biography subject's (Aolugan's) mother; English "his mother" after Yudu wrongly makes Literary Consort Yudu's mother.

In the first year of Baoda, Southern Army commander-in-chief Yelu Yudu and his mother Literary Consort secretly plotted to install him; when the affair was discovered Yudu surrendered to Jin, Literary Consort was executed, and Aolugan had in truth not joined the plot and was spared.
